title: USA DS-160 preparation and accuracy — Department of State FAQ
text:
USA DS-160 nonimmigrant visa application preparation: answer accurately and completely. Errors may require corrections and rescheduling. Submitting DS-160 does not by itself complete the visa application; follow the embassy or consulate's interview instructions.

Have your passport, any existing itinerary, previous US travel dates, and education and employment information available. F, J and M applicants need their SEVIS ID from Form I-20 or DS-2019, and the school or program address. Answers use English characters except where the form requests a name in the native alphabet. Consult the official FAQ for correction procedures; do not guess missing personal information.
